recipes.title: Pan-Seared Pacific Halibut with Lemon-Caper Butter
recipes.description: Crispy golden crust with tender, buttery white flakes basted in wine, lemon juice, capers, and fresh herbs.
ingredients: Sea salt & freshly cracked black pepper
instructions: Pat halibut portions thoroughly dry with paper towels. Season generously with sea salt and cracked pepper.
Heat avocado oil in a stainless steel or cast-iron skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering.
Carefully lay fillets into the pan. Sear undisturbed for 4 minutes until a deep golden crust forms.
Gently flip fillets. Add butter, smashed garlic, and capers to the pan. Tilt skillet and spoon foamy butter continuously over the fish for 3-4 minutes.
Remove from heat, squeeze fresh lemon juice over top, sprinkle parsley, and serve immediately with pan juices.

recipes.title: Cedar Plank Wild Sockeye Salmon with Maple Dijon Glaze
recipes.description: Smoky, sweet, and tangy. The cedar plank imparts aromatic Pacific Northwest forest smoke directly into the vibrant wild sockeye.
ingredients: 4 x 6oz Wild Alaskan Sockeye Salmon fillets
1 Western Red Cedar Grilling Plank (soaked in water for 1 hr)
2 tbsp pure maple syrup or wildflower honey
1 tbsp coarse whole grain Dijon mustard
instructions: Preheat outdoor grill to medium-high (375°F-400°F).
Whisk together maple syrup, Dijon mustard, soy sauce, and minced garlic.
Place soaked cedar plank directly on grill grates for 3 minutes until it begins to lightly crackle and smoke.
Flip plank over, place salmon fillets skin-side down on the charred side of the plank.
Brush glaze liberally over each fillet. Close grill lid and smoke-roast for 12-14 minutes until center registers 130°F (medium-rare to medium). Garnish with fresh dill.

recipes.title: Golden Caramelized Jumbo Scallops in Garlic Herb Ghee
recipes.description: Restaurant-quality dry-pack sea scallops seared to caramelized perfection with a sweet, succulent center.
ingredients: 1.5 tbsp clarified butter (ghee) or grapeseed oil
Coarse kosher salt & fresh cracked pepper
instructions: Remove side muscle from scallops if present. Place between paper towels on a plate in the fridge for 20 minutes to draw out all exterior moisture.
Season flat sides right before placing into the pan with salt and pepper.
Heat cast iron skillet over high heat until very hot. Add ghee.
Place scallops clockwise in pan with ample space between them. Sear undisturbed for 2 minutes until deep caramel crust develops.
Flip scallops once, add butter, shallot, and thyme sprig. Baste for 60 to 90 seconds. Scallops should be translucent and tender in center. Plate immediately.

recipes.title: Hawaiian Sesame-Ginger Ahi Tuna Poke Bowl
recipes.description: Ultra-fresh ruby red ahi cubed and tossed in toasted sesame oil, tamari, scallions, sweet Maui onions, and avocado.
ingredients: 2 x 6oz Sashimi Grade Yellowfin Ahi Steaks (cubed into 3/4-inch bites)
2 tbsp low-sodium tamari or soy sauce
1/4 cup thinly sliced sweet Maui or red onion
1 tsp toasted white & black sesame seeds
Warm jasmine rice, sliced avocado, edamame, and pickled ginger for serving
instructions: Thaw ahi tuna completely in the refrigerator inside packaging, then pat completely dry.
Cut tuna steaks into clean 3/4-inch cubes with a sharp non-serrated knife.
In a glass mixing bowl, whisk tamari, sesame oil, and sriracha.
Gently fold in ahi cubes, sliced scallions, and sweet onion until evenly coated. Chill for 10 minutes.
Scoop warm sushi rice into bowls, top with marinated ahi poke, sliced avocado, cucumber, edamame, and sprinkle sesame seeds.
